title: Te Kuao Kau Koura i Peia
intro: Nā tētahi tangata i whakahuatia i roto i te Quran i ārahi te mano tini ki te hē i te ngaronga atu o tētahi poropiti rangatira. Nā tētahi mea i hangaia ki te koura i hopu ngā ngākau o tētahi iwi katoa — engari ka mutu te kōrero mō tēnei tangata i roto i te mokemoke me te kanga tauhou. Ko wai rā tēnei tangata i peia atu?
clues: I puta mai ahau i te wā e ngaro atu ana tētahi poropiti nui i kake ki te whiwhi i te arataki a te Atua.
Nāku i he ai te mano tini ki tetahi mea i hanga e ōku ake ringaringa.
Te āhua nei he ora te mea koura i hangaia e au, ā, i puta mai he oro i miharo ai te hunga i whai i a ia.
I kī ahau kua kite ahau i ngā mea kāore e taea e ētahi atu te kite — he tirohanga ki te mea kāore e kitea.
I unuhia e ahau tetahi mea i ngā tapuwae o te karere atua, ā, maka ana e ahau ki roto ki te konganuku rewa.
I whiua ahau kia kopikopiko ko au anake, me te kanga ahurei e kore e taea e tetahi te pa ki toku kiri, e kore hoki ahau e pa ki o ratou.

Poropiti Salih

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: I hanga he kuao kau koura hei karakia
I hanga he pourewa e anga atu ana ki te rangi
I wero i ngā tohunga makutu o Ihipa
I ārahi i tētahi ope taua me ngā kararehe rere
Wehea te marama hei tohu o te poropititanga
trial.answer: I hanga he kuao kau koura hei karakia

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: Te kuao kau koura
He tokotoko i huri hei nakahi
He rakau e mura ana i runga i te maunga
He āaka e takoto ana i runga i te tihi
He awaawa kī tonu i te ahi mura

outcome.label: Hua
options: I pei atu, i āraia kia kaua e pā atu, e pā atu rānei ki ētahi atu
I toremi ki te moana me te ope taua
I tahuna oratia mō te whakakāhore i te whakapono
I pāngia e te hau kaha, e haruru ana
Kua murua, ā, kua whakaarahia ki te tūranga teitei
outcome.answer: I pei atu, i āraia kia kaua e pā atu, e pā atu rānei ki ētahi atu

arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
verse: [Allāh] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Sāmirī has led them astray." (20:85)
